fusions.name: Stoop
fusions.desc: Dives up to 7 tiles onto the target and lands shield-first, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Discus
fusions.desc: Sends the shield gliding at a failing enemy, dealing 18 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Alight and Brace
fusions.desc: Moves you 3 tiles from where you stood, raises your armour by 15% for 8 seconds and makes you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Carried on the Wind
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
